added.title: Software Engineer, Fleet Systems
added.description:
Position Overview

We're looking for an experienced software engineer to develop, deploy, and improve the software powering our autonomous vehicle fleet. You'll work across the onboard software stack, building new capabilities, improving system reliability, and solving engineering challenges that arise from operating autonomous vehicles in the real world.

This is a hands-on role combining software development with direct involvement in our fleet. You'll work closely with our software engineering and fleet operations teams to implement features, investigate system behavior, and build tools that help us develop, test, and operate our vehicles more effectively.

We're open to a range of experience levels and value strong technical fundamentals, independent problem-solving, and the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar systems.

This is an on-site role based in San Francisco.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain software across our onboard systems, including runtime services, sensor interfaces, networking, and logging.
Investigate and resolve software issues using logs, telemetry, and hands-on testing.
Implement features, bug fixes, and system improvements based on real-world fleet experience.
Deploy, configure, and validate software releases on vehicles.
Build diagnostic tools, scripts, and automation to improve fleet reliability and engineering efficiency.
Work closely with fleet operations and other engineering teams to support vehicle testing and continuously improve our software stack.

Minimum Qualifications

Strong software engineering fundamentals and proficiency in at least one programming language.
Experience with Linux systems, command-line tools, and software debugging.
Ability to systematically investigate complex technical problems and identify root causes.
Comfortable working across software and hardware interfaces.
Strong ownership, communication skills, and ability to work independently.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with robotics, autonomous vehicles, embedded systems, or distributed systems.
Experience with Python, Rust, or C++.
Experience with sensors, networking, telemetry, or data logging.
Experience with software deployment, system monitoring, or test automation.
Experience developing software for systems deployed on physical hardware.

added.title: Full Stack Engineer - Onsite - San Francisco, CA
added.description:
**************** ONLY US Citizens or Green Card Holders *
*******************

What we're looking for
We need a full stack engineer with 2-3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience who has built and maintained real products that people use, across both frontend and backend in a JavaScript/TypeScript stack (React, Next.js, Node.js/Express). You should be comfortable on a small, fast team where you push code in your first week and own a system soon after, and you should have a track record of shipping production features quickly at startups or on small teams. Bonus points if you're a former founder or early startup engineer, have built testing frameworks, or have worked with ETL/data pipelines, simple ML models, or 3D CAD and 2D drawing/OCR files.

What you'll do
Work on Vendra's existing platforms, including the customer marketplace, the supplier portal, and the internal custom ERP. You'll take tickets every day, fix bugs, and ship improvements that customers, suppliers, and the internal ops team use right away.
Own one of our core production systems within your first few weeks, and keep it reliable and improving as request volume grows.
Work directly with the CTO (Anish), the founding team, and a three-person engineering team to turn ambiguous customer and supplier requests into working software.
Build and expand test frameworks across our products to keep our systems healthy. This is a major current initiative, and this hire will get significant ownership of it.
Lead features from scoping to production across React/Next.js frontends, Node.js/Express and Python backends, Postgres/MongoDB data layers, and AWS infrastructure (commercial and GovCloud).
Build and improve backend APIs, ETL pipelines, and AI-driven workflows that analyze customer CAD files and drawings, so more of the manufacturing procurement process runs automatically, from RFQ through delivery.

Requirements

Dealbreaker (MUST HAVE)

Work experience
Experience across the stack building and shipping real products into production

Hard skills
Shipped production code in a JavaScript/TypeScript web stack (React/Next.​js,​ Node/Express)

Baseline

Seniority
1 -​ 3 years of experience as a full stack engineer ( 2 -​ 3 YOE is ideal;​ also open to stand-​out new grads with strong internship experience )

Work experience
Experience at a startup (Seed -​ Series C),​ as a founder,​ or on a small team that moved very quickly

Nice-to-have

Hard skills
Experience working with 3D CAD files or 2D OCR
Experience developing automated testing frameworks

Salary : $120K - $150K
Equity 0.05% - 0.1%

On-site work policy
On-site 5 days a week at Vendra's new office in San Francisco, which is easy to commute to. Relocation: the HM said on the call he is open to relocation. Travel: in office every day.
